children: Overview
UK diagnostics maker's H1 revenue was flat yr/yr, while gross margin improved
Adjusted EBITDA rose 2.4%, driven by higher margin product revenues
Company continued share buyback programme during H1 2026
Outlook
EKF expects FY 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA in line with market expectations
Company sees stronger H2 performance driven by Point-of-Care Hematology shipments and β-HB growth
Company maintains five-year plan to exceed £80 mln revenue and £20 mln adjusted EBITDA by 2029
Result Drivers
PRODUCT MIX - Co said gross margin and adjusted EBITDA were driven by higher margin product revenues, especially β-HB and consumables
LIFE SCIENCES GROWTH - Growth in β-HB and Contract Manufacturing revenues contributed to H1 performance, with β-HB up 4% and Contract Manufacturing up 25%
ORDER TIMING - Point-of-Care revenue was flat, impacted by timing of customer orders and tender awards; delayed revenue expected to be recognised in H2
